title: Amrize to expand Memphis cement terminal
summary: Amrize to expand Memphis cement terminal
body_markdown:
**US:** Amrize is investing US$16m in the expansion and modernisation of its cement terminal in Memphis, Tennessee, to strengthen supply across Western Tennessee, Eastern Arkansas and Northern Mississippi. The project, due for completion in mid-2027, will add a 4000t elevated storage silo, a second automated self-service loading bay and improved barge access on the Mississippi River.


The expanded terminal will distribute cement from Amrize’s plant in Ste. Genevieve, Missouri, and introduce Grade 100 slag cement to the region. The company said that the investment would improve storage capacity and streamline customer logistics.
